title: The Watcher's Threshold
description: An AI proposer is wrong a few percent of the time, but UMA pays a winning disputer only half the bond it risks — so the break-even belief is two-thirds, not half. Every category's base error rate sits deep in the no-dispute zone; raise the reward and the threshold slides left.
controls: click the chart to set your belief
